title: Cadence: LinkedIn posts in your own voice, from two minutes a week. $20/month after a 7-day trial.
Everything is visible: 12 settings you choose once, 5 weekly actions, 10 automatic routines
Every draft is fixed, rewritten once, or held for you, by the same published rules
Sign in. Real users use LinkedIn's official sign-in; the demo uses a throwaway account
Card first, 7 days free. Real users go to Stripe Checkout; the demo takes no card
Setup 1 of 3: who you are, who you want to reach, and the only facts Cadence may state
Setup 2 of 3: three of your own posts teach it your voice, plus topics and a never-write-about list
Setup 3 of 3: posts per week, days, time, and the writing model (Claude Sonnet 5 or Opus 5)
Each week: two minutes of rough notes. That's the only regular input
Cadence writes 2 versions of each post in your voice, checks both, and keeps the better one
Drafts are ready. Nothing posts until you approve it
Why this draft: the angle, every check it passed, what was fixed automatically, and what it cost
Edit anything. Your version is re-checked but never rewritten: you're the author
Approved: the exact text is locked and scheduled into your next posting slot, in your time zone
Or post now. It goes out once through LinkedIn's official API (recorded, not sent, in the demo)
Published. Results arrive once LinkedIn approves analytics; the demo shows sample numbers
Settings: edit your setup, see this month's model use, and unlock automatic posting after 5 clean approvals
Every rule is public. Run it yourself: git clone, pnpm install, pnpm demo. MIT licensed.
